killedBy: vendored third-party source (issue #771) renders every vendored source, its files and its notice into THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md is generated, not hand-edited matches what renderNotices() produces right now -- run `npm run notices` to fix
why: A section that names its origin and quotes its notice but not the files that carry it leaves a reader unable to tell which code the notice governs. Every vendored file must be named in its section.
